[EN] One of the Consos clan, Thakun, was due back from Allemantheia, but his pegasus arrived empty."He fell?"
[ES] Thakun, uno del clan Consos, tenía que regresar de Allemantheia, pero su pegasus llegó vacío."He fell?"

[EN] Likely. Reading a book, no doubt.

I doubt he survived, but his family will want the body."I'll keep my eyes open."
[ES] Es probable. Leyendo un libro, sin duda.

Dudo que haya sobrevivido, pero su familia querrá el cuerpo."I'll keep my eyes open."
